description.zh-CN: 把动漫插画转成纯路径分层 SVG，用于 Lumina 叠色 3D 打印版画。
description.en-US: Convert anime illustrations into layered path-only SVG for stacked-color 3D printmaking.

permissions.name: image.pick
permissions.reason: 由用户选择要转换的插画，读取像素后交给后端描摹

permissions.name: color-library.read
permissions.reason: 交接时读取当前宿主色库 ID，供 Lumina 转换器核对颜色

permissions.name: handoff.image
permissions.reason: 把生成的分层 SVG 与兼容 PNG 交给 Lumina 转换器
